content:
incident-bot: [ALERT] High 5xx rate in eu3b inference pool (model-serving-prod). Automated threshold triggered at 2026-08-14T09:07:14Z.
anya_sre: acked. looking now — switching to #eng-runtime for visibility.
ravi_platform: on it, pulling logs + metrics. any recent deploys to eu3b?
luis_runtime: not from runtime team in last 12h. I see a spike in TCP retransmits and kernel drops on nodes in eu3b-az1. Dashboard: https://dash.redwood/example/graphs?range=30m
anya_sre: customer-impact? are calls failing or just slower?
eng-runtime: partial failures. ~8% 5xx for text-gen endpoints, latency p95 up from 120ms -> 1.2s. some requests are timing out and falling back to smaller model.
customer-success: we have two paying customers routed to eu3 (region tag eu-west-3): "BrightDocs" and "NotePulse" — CC'ing their CS reps.
luis_runtime: grabbing node diagnostics via ssh to a few affected instances. seeing NIC queue length growing, interrupts backlog. suspect ENI or host network driver.
ravi_platform: checking AZ control-plane — no planned maintenance. AWS Health shows no region-wide outage but one SUBNET (subnet-eu3b-az1) has recent "Reachability" warnings.
anya_sre: good. mitigation options: 1) steer traffic away from eu3b to eu3a/eu3c 2) increase retry/backoff + fallback to smaller model 3) initiate node drain + replace if NIC flakey. prefer (1) short term.
luis_runtime: agree. Routing: we can update the smart-router policy to mark eu3b as degraded and shift 80% traffic to eu3a with 20% to eu3c, TTL short. I can push a canary in 2 mins.
eng-runtime: prepare the routing config snippet below — setting penalty weight and lowering route priority.
```
# smart-router policy patch
region: eu3
az_penalty:
  eu3b: 1000
  eu3a: 10
  eu3c: 20
session_affinity_ttl: 15s
```
luis_runtime: applying canary now to 10% -> monitor.
incident-bot: action: route-policy/patch started by luis_runtime at 2026-08-14T09:10:05Z.
anya_sre: monitoring metrics — dashboards show 10% shift, 5xx dropped to 5% within 90s. good signal. keep increasing.
ravi_platform: increasing to 60% now. Also adding short-circuit on DNS at edge: reduce resolver TTL for inference.eu3.redwood.ai to 10s to accelerate client reroute.
eng-runtime: TTL change pushed. note: some long-lived connections will still stick until reconnect.
luis_runtime: increased to 85% away from eu3b. 5xx now 1.1%, p95 back to ~150ms.
customer-success: pinging BrightDocs — they reported timeouts 09:05-09:12Z, but no new errors after ~09:13Z.
anya_sre: nice work. next: we should drain and reprovision the most affected hosts in eu3b. can we cordon+terminate safely?
luis_runtime: starting drain on 3 nodes, autoscaler will spin new ones in other AZs if capacity needed. drain command: ```kubectl drain node/ip-10-0-45-13 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-emptydir-data``` 
ravi_platform: note: reserved capacity for eu3b is high; autoscaler may take time. as medium-term mitigation, recommend enabling cross-az burst capacity in Dedicated pools for this customer cohort.
eng-runtime: agree — raising ticket for Dedicated config. Not for immediate but important.
incident-bot: pagerduty: page acknowledged by anya_sre at 2026-08-14T09:11:22Z.
anya_sre: handing off to night oncall in 45m. ravi, please prepare a short incident summary and mark whether we need an immediate postmortem.
ravi_platform: summary: transient single-AZ host/network degradation in eu3b due to NIC queue/backpressure. Mitigated by routing traffic away (policy patch + DNS TTL shorten) and draining 3 nodes. Customer impact: ~8% 5xx peak, two enterprise customers saw timeouts for ~7 minutes. Root cause still under investigation — collecting host kernel/traces and ENI metrics; AWS Health shows local subnet reachability warnings. Recommend postmortem and follow-up with AWS support.
luis_runtime: logs collected and attached to incident runbook: s3://redwood-incidents/2640001234/logs.tar.gz
customer-success: CS will follow up with BrightDocs and NotePulse with timeline and mitigation steps.
eng-runtime: setting temporary alert threshold to catch reappearance for 24h, and enabling automatic route penalty if packet drops > X.
anya_sre: perfect. I'll mark this as "mitigated" and start the incident timeline doc. handoff: @luis_runtime you'll lead the post-incident kernel/driver analysis, @ravi_platform you'll coordinate AWS ticket and capacity follow-ups. I'll take write-up and customer comms.
pagerduty: incident resolved? please update status when stable.
anya_sre: closing the active page for now — will re-open if we see degradation. moving to post-incident thread for timeline and actions. :white_check_mark:
eng-runtime: noted — leaving extra tracing for 12h.
incident-bot: Incident status changed to MITIGATED at 2026-08-14T09:17:55Z by anya_sre.
